in_marathi.name: Reyhna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Reyhna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Reyhna is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', which means 'Night', 'Moon', and 'Jasmine'. This beautiful name is associated with the night sky and the calming presence of the moon.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Reyhna' is a combination of 'Rey' and 'Hina'. 'Rey' has Sanskrit origins and means 'ruler, king'. 'Hina' is of Persian origin and means 'humble' or 'low'. The name can be interpreted as 'Humble Rey' or 'Rey with humility'.
